items.label: Application Name
items.description: The public-facing name of the application.
items.long_description: This name will appear in emails, browser tabs, and the main dashboard header.

items.label: Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication
items.description: Require all staff accounts to use MFA.
items.long_description: When enabled, users without MFA configured will be forced to set it up on their next login.

items.label: Primary Auth Method
items.long_description: Use local for username/password, or a bridge name such as google or keycloak.

items.label: Enabled Auth Methods
items.description: Auth methods exposed on the login page and auth API.
items.long_description: Always include local unless the instance is IdP-only.

items.label: Allow Local Registration
items.long_description: When false, only administrators or IdP provisioning can create users.

items.label: Email Alert Digest
items.description: How often system alert summaries are sent.
items.long_description: Choose realtime, daily, or weekly summaries for system-level event logging.
